title: DELIBERATIVE DYNAMICS AND VALUE ALIGNMENT IN LLM DEBATES

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing how often models change their initial verdicts to agree with other models across different deliberation formats (synchronous vs. round-robin) and quantifying this tendency using conformity parameters in a multinomial logistic model.
Measuring models' resistance to revising their initial moral judgments after being exposed to counterarguments, quantified via an inertia parameter in a multinomial logistic model.

Classifying the underlying moral principles and values (e.g., personal autonomy, empathy) that LLMs invoke to justify blame assignment in everyday dilemmas from Reddit's 'Am I the Asshole', utilizing a 48-value taxonomy to track value alignment and preference shifts.
